assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: Development intensity, height, density and setbacks stay unknown in metrics.json rather than being filled with estimates.

assumptions.statement: The corridor boundary and the three key-area outlines are provisional geometry generated by the participant from public inputs, not an official redline or a precise-area basis.
assumptions.impact: Areas and ratios carry low confidence and are reported only at an approximate magnitude; the whole package must be recomputed when official polygons are published.

assumptions.statement: Road boundary lines, cross-sections, under-bridge title and intersection forms have not been obtained.
assumptions.impact: The mobility layer states connectivity and stitching priorities only; no cross-section, redline or grade-separation conclusion is offered.

assumptions.statement: Rail station design and the extent of railway-heritage protection are unconfirmed.
assumptions.impact: Station-city integration at Dazhongsi is deferred to the mid term and the protection belt is registered as a pending extent in the constraint layer.

assumptions.statement: Parcel ownership, campus edges and ground-floor title are unconfirmed.
assumptions.impact: Pedestrian links and ground-floor conversion are written with a title-negotiation precondition and a reduced single-point fallback.

assumptions.statement: No survey of existing buildings, structural safety or heritage value is available.
assumptions.impact: All building clusters are marked pending_survey; the retain-renovate-demolish work states a method only and reaches no demolition conclusion.

assumptions.statement: Utility pipelines, energy capacity, drainage, flood control and fire-safety conditions have not been obtained.
assumptions.impact: Water-related works, distributed energy and edge-compute siting are recorded as preconditions rather than feasibility conclusions.

assumptions.statement: Proposed operating bodies, cross-regional cooperation interfaces and policy instruments have not been agreed by any organisation.
assumptions.impact: Operator columns, coordination loops and policy tools are presented as design proposals and never as settled arrangements.
